$comment: Copyleft components that ship, and the runtime-only native codecs excluded from the distributed dependency graph. Each entry records a decision and its reason. scripts/licensing/third-party-notices.mjs checks copyleft placement against client banners. Diagram entries marked `paths: false` with `placement: none` also require the existing render-path checks. The `runtimeOnly` codec decisions instead describe the audited file-only Workspace setup; they are not validated by the unrelated mermaid render-path checks. Reassess them if backends or imports change. Only edges into these codecs stop traversal; dependencies also reachable through ordinary production edges remain listed.

reasons.name: elkjs
reasons.does: The ELK layout engine mermaid uses for `layout: elk` diagrams
reasons.reason: Kept, not dropped. EPL-2.0 is file-level copyleft: unmodified (source at github.com/kieler/elkjs) as a binary inside a GPL-3.0-or-later work, it asks only that the source stay available, which a public build already satisfies. It rides in mermaid's diagram chunk and nothing in this app reaches it: `src/lib/ui/mermaid.ts` initializes mermaid with `layout: 'dagre'`, and `mermaidText()` in `src/lib/pulls/pullGraph.ts` encodes `#`, `%` and `<` out of every title, branch and label, so repository content, model output and PR titles cannot open a `%%{init}%%` directive or a `flowchart-elk` diagram. Dropping it would cost `flowchart-elk` rendering for 1.4 MB nobody downloads by default.

reasons.name: node-liblzma
reasons.does: liblzma binding that just-bash (@cloudflare/computer) uses for .tar.xz archives
reasons.reason: This optional native codec is not shipped. `Workspace` is constructed with storage only, without backends, in `worker/src/merge/resolver.ts` and `worker/src/review/agent-reviewer.ts`; their `createPiTools({ workspace })` setup exposes file tools, not command execution. just-bash loads `node-liblzma` dynamically inside its tar xz codec. The audited Worker bundle contains no native codec. Exclude this node and dependencies reachable only through it whether installation succeeded or not; retain any dependency also reachable from an ordinary production edge. Adding a shell backend or another import requires a new distribution decision.

reasons.name: @mongodb-js/zstd
reasons.does: Optional native Zstandard codec loaded by just-bash's tar command
reasons.reason: The same audited file-only Workspaces do not expose just-bash command execution. Its tar zstd codec dynamically imports this optional native module; the audited Worker bundle contains no native codec. Installation availability must not change the notices, while shared dependencies reached through ordinary production edges must remain listed. Reassess this exclusion if backends or imports change.
